title: Nyeredzi Gumi Nerimwe Dzakakotama
intro: Munhu anobva muKorani akapihwa chiono chakadzama achiri mudiki - kurota kwezvisikwa zvekudenga zvichikotama zvichiremekedza. Makore aizopfuura nekutengeswa, kuparadzaniswa, kupomerwa nhema, uye kuiswa mujeri chiono ichi chisati chazadziswa. Ndiani mweya uyu une simba une nyaya yakareba kupfuura dzose muchitsauko cheKorani?
clues: Ndakambova mudiki, ndakakomborerwa nehope dzinoshamisa dzandakatoudzwa nababa vangu kuti ndisazvichengetere zvakavanzika.
Hama dzangu chaidzo, dzakapofumadzwa negodo, dzakandirongera zano ndokundikanda mugomba rakadzika, rine rima.
Ndakatakurwa kuenda kunyika iri kure ndikatengeswa mumba memukuru wehurumende, kwandakawana nyasha ndikasimuka pakuva nemutoro.
Kupomerwa nhema kwakaita kuti ndisungwe zvisina kururama, asi munzvimbo iyoyo yerima ndakawana nyaradzo mukunyengetera nekugwadamira kuna Allah.
Allah akandikomborera nekugona kushoma kududzira hope, izvo zvakazondisvitsa pamberi pemutongi wenyika uye zvakandisimudzira pachinzvimbo chepamusoro chekuvimba.
Mushure memakore akawanda ekuparadzana, ndakabatanazve nemhuri yangu yandinoda, uye hope dzangu dzehudiki dzenyeredzi gumi neimwe, zuva, nemwedzi zvichindikotamira dzakazozadzikiswa.

arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِى ٱشْتَرَىٰهُ مِن مِّصْرَ لِٱمْرَأَتِهِۦٓ أَكْرِمِى مَثْوَىٰهُ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَنفَعَنَآ أَوْ نَتَّخِذَهُۥ وَلَدًۭا ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ مَكَّنَّا لِيُوسُفَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلِنُعَلِّمَهُۥ مِن تَأْوِيلِ ٱلْأَحَادِيثِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَالِبٌ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْرِهِۦ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verse: And the one from Egypt who bought him said to his wife, "Make his residence comfortable. Perhaps he will benefit us, or we will adopt him as a son." And thus, We established Joseph in the land that We might teach him the interpretation of events [i.e., dreams]. And Allāh is predominant over His affair, but most of the people do not know. (12:21)
